name: @mercatus-liber/media
description: Image-CDN subsystem (image-cdn epic): owns the ImageAdapter contract every real image-CDN/transform provider implements (mirrors @mercatus-liber/payments' PaymentAdapter and @mercatus-liber/shipping's ShippingAdapter shape -- a small interface the app wires at startup, swappable with zero changes anywhere else). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only for the ProductImage type it operates on. Ships createPassthroughImageAdapter() as the zero-infra default -- returns the source URL unchanged, a genuinely honest "no transform/optimization available" default, never a fabricated resized URL.
